Open items left after the 0.2.0 code-quality work. Each one changes behaviour in some case, so each needs a decision and, for a fix, a test that fails on the current code first. Line numbers refer to the 0.2.0 sources. Find the current sites with lintr::lint_package() (vector_logic_linter, seq_linter).

1. | and & inside if() (vector_logic_linter, 31 lines)

if() needs one TRUE/FALSE value. || and && give that and stop early, but switching is not always a pure style change:

  • || / && do not evaluate the right-hand side when the left decides the result. That can avoid an error, or skip one, that the current code hits.
  • Since R 4.3, || / && raise an error for arguments of length > 1, where | / & silently give a vector (and if() errors only if that vector is not of length 1).

Check each site for the length of both sides before changing it.

  • R/checking.R:9 — identical(...) | identical(...) | ... (scalars; safe to switch)
  • R/checking.R:97 — !missing(id) & !is.null(output)

2. 1:n where n can be 0 (seq_linter, 19 sites)

When n is 0, 1:n is c(1, 0): the loop runs twice with nonsense indices and usually fails with an unrelated error. seq_len(n) / seq_along(x) would run zero times, which changes the result for that input. (The sites where n is always at least 1 were already changed in 0.2.0.)

Inputs that reach n = 0:

  • R/checking.R:77 — 1:ncol(data): inspect.data() when no column of data is in info$varname
  • R/checking.R:110 — 1:length(info$varname): same, with plot = TRUE
  • R/ssformat.R:61, :78, :95 — rownames(sstable) <- 1:nrow(sstable): a table with no rows
  • R/ssformat.R:161, :174 — ss_guess_format() on a table with no rows
  • R/ssformat.R:270, :292, :301, :330, :463, :574 — 1:ncol(...): a table with no columns
  • R/sstable.ae.R:251 — 1:length(grade): a character grade.var that is all NA (._grade_order() drops NA)
  • R/sstable.baseline.R:390, :483 — 1:length(levels(x)): a row variable with no non-missing value, with a third-dimension variable
  • R/sstable.survcomp.subgroup.R:108 — 1:length(subgroup.char): subgroup.model = ~1
  • R/sstable.survcomp.subgroup.R:193 — 1:length(factor.levels): a subgroup variable that is all NA
  • R/toolkits.R:93 — 1:nrow(Map): simple_recode() with an empty map

For most of these the better fix is an input check with a clear error (c306_abort()), not only seq_len().

3. Depends vs Imports

DESCRIPTION has Depends: data.table, dplyr. library(C306) therefore attaches both packages to the user’s search path, which can mask functions (e.g. dplyr::filter() masks stats::filter(), and data.table and dplyr both define between(), first() and last()). Moving them to Imports is the usual practice, but scripts that rely on library(C306) to make dplyr or data.table functions available would then need their own library() calls. That is a user-visible change: decide, announce it in NEWS, and check the vignette and the project templates in inst/structure.
